test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

I will definitely __return your notes at__ Saturday evening.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'at Saturday evening' is incorrect.
 
• The correct preposition to use with a specific day is **'on'** and for a general time frame **'by'** can be appropriate.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be 'by Saturday evening'.

Hence, the correct sentence is '***I will definitely return your notes by __Saturday evening*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to a specific day and time, the correct preposition is **'on'**.

 
 
• **Example:** ***I will meet you on Monday morning.***
 
 
 
• When referring to a deadline or a general time frame, the correct preposition is **'by'**.
 
 
• **Example:** ***Please submit the report by Friday evening.***
